data_fields.name: shop_item_price
data_fields.donor_constant: template.Price per item, from the merchant trade list

data_fields.name: pack_size
data_fields.donor_constant: template.PackSize; 0 means one item per count

data_fields.name: price_one_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: Price 1 that rounds to 0 pays Price x count / pack

best_idea: A shop reads its price from its own list and the client sends only an item and a count; a buy or sell is one check-then-apply step that moves no money when a check fails.
decision_why: The server-read price and check-then-apply shape fit the one ledger; the donor grants before debiting, so Frankendom debits and grants in one step, and the sell-back ratio becomes per-shop zone data.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a failed buy (no funds or no space) changes neither wallet nor inventory, buying 3 at price 100 debits 300 and grants 3, selling a price-199 item at ratio 50 credits 99, and a non-droppable item sells for 0 and is not removed.
